# Changelog

All notable changes to Memento-Skills are documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
and this project aspires to follow [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

<!-- Generated by the doc-pipeline skill on 2026-04-13; [Unreleased] appended on 2026-04-13 pipeline re-run. -->

## [Unreleased]

### Added

- **Tech-writing skill suite** — six Cowork-format skills for documentation
  work, plus an orchestrator (c41aa41):
  - `style-checker` — knowledge skill that reviews Markdown against a
    30-rule style guide (`skills/style-checker/references/style-guide.md`)
    and auto-fixes mechanical issues while flagging judgment calls.
  - `changelog-writer` — hybrid skill that parses conventional-commit git
    history via `scripts/git_log_parser.py` and categorizes entries into
    Keep a Changelog sections.
  - `doc-freshness` — hybrid skill whose `scripts/doc_freshness_scanner.py`
    scans a `docs/` tree against git history and classifies each file as
    fresh / possibly_stale / likely_stale.
  - `doc-generator` — hybrid skill that extracts signatures from Python
    (AST-based), C#, and TypeScript (regex-based) via
    `scripts/extract_signatures.py`, with reference, configuration, and
    getting-started templates.
  - `release-notes` — knowledge skill for audience-calibrated release notes
    (developer / end-user / ops / executive) with tone examples.
  - `doc-pipeline` — orchestrator that runs the other five in sequence,
    logs results to `docs/.doc-pipeline-log.json`, and works around the
    framework's no-skill-to-skill-invocation constraint by invoking
    sibling scripts directly.
- **Tech-writing adaptation plan** at `docs/tech-writing-adaptation-plan.md`
  — phased plan for adapting Memento-Skills' skill-learning loop to
  technical-writing workflows (c41aa41).
- **Pipeline feedback log** at `docs/.doc-pipeline-log.json` — seed of a
  utility-scoring feedback loop for tracking pipeline runs over time
  (c41aa41).
- **`docs/design/`** — design-note directory for tech-writing-skill
  changes. First entry: `doc-freshness-relevance-filter.md`.
- **`skills/doc-freshness/scripts/test_relevance.py`** — 17-test suite for
  the relevance filter. Runs via `python test_relevance.py`; no pytest
  dependency.
- **Phase 1 retrospective** at `docs/phase-1-retrospective.md`.
- **First-pass API reference** at `docs/api/skill-gateway.md`, generated
  from `core/skill/gateway.py` by the `doc-generator` skill.
- **Test fixture** at `test-fixtures/columnviewwidth.mdx` — auto-fixed
  output from a `style-checker` run against external input.

### Changed

- **`doc-freshness` relevance filter rewritten** — replaced the fuzzy
  substring heuristic with directory-prefix path overlap. Backtick-quoted
  topics and commit subjects are no longer matched; only commit files that
  overlap with paths the doc explicitly references count as "related
  changes." Fixes the false-positive pattern documented in
  `docs/.doc-pipeline-log.json` where meta-commits to `skills/` or
  `docs/` flagged unrelated design docs. See
  `docs/design/doc-freshness-relevance-filter.md` for rationale. Verified
  by `skills/doc-freshness/scripts/test_relevance.py` (17 tests).

## [0.2.0] - 2026-03-31

Major architecture upgrade. Introduces Bounded Context boundaries across the
agent and skill subsystems, a three-layer configuration model, a cloud Skill
Market, and a cross-platform IM Gateway.

### Added

- **Skill Market** — cloud search, download, and auto-install flow for sharing
  skills across installations (f05f9bc).
- **Multi-platform IM Gateway** — unified messaging layer spanning Feishu,
  DingTalk, WeCom, and WeChat, each with its own adapter under `3rd/` (f05f9bc).
- **`im-platform` built-in skill** — exposes the IM Gateway to agents as a
  first-class skill (f05f9bc).
- **GUI workspace browser** — visual session and skill management UI alongside
  the existing CLI (f05f9bc).
- **Test suite, build scripts, and bootstrap entry point** — `bootstrap.py`,
  `build_scripts/`, and CI workflow under `.github/workflows/build.yml` to
  standardize packaging and verification (f05f9bc).

### Changed

- **BREAKING: Bounded Context architecture redesign** — the agent and skill
  modules were re-partitioned into explicit bounded contexts. Public module
  layouts under `core/` changed; integrations that import internals will need
  to be re-pointed (f05f9bc).
- **BREAKING: Configuration system v2** — three-layer isolation across System,
  User, and Runtime scopes. Existing single-file configurations must be
  migrated into the new layered layout (f05f9bc).
- **Execution engine refactor** — adds a Tool Bridge abstraction, policy hooks,
  richer error recovery, and a loop-detection guard around the ReAct loop
  (f05f9bc).
- README rewritten for the v0.2.0 release (f05f9bc, c8f91b6, adc2080).

## [0.1.0] - 2026-03-19

### Added

- Initial public commit of Memento-Skills — ReAct-based agent core, skill
